name: Sender Domain Health: SPF, DKIM & DMARC Check and Monitor

nodes.name: Schedule: Every Monday 08:00
nodes.notes: Weekly check. DNS changes rarely, so weekly is enough to catch a record someone edited.

nodes.name: Manual: Run Now
nodes.notes: Run a check on demand, for example right after a DNS change.

nodes.name: Domains to Watch
nodes.notes: The list of sending domains. Edit it here, or replace the node with a Google Sheets read.

nodes.name: DNS Lookups (Public DNS, No Credentials)
nodes.notes: Asks public DNS for SPF (following every include), DMARC, MX and the listed DKIM selectors. No credentials: it reads what any mailbox provider reads.

nodes.name: Rules: Grade the Domain (No AI)
nodes.notes: Fixed rules, no AI. Each finding carries the issue, what it means in plain words and the fix. FAIL = a blocker, WARN = warnings only, ERROR = DNS could not be read.

nodes.name: Compare With Last Run
nodes.notes: Compares each verdict with the previous run (kept in the workflow's static data on scheduled runs): new, same, worse, better or changed.

nodes.name: Build Digest and Alert
nodes.notes: One digest for every run, and an alert text only when a domain got worse, fails on first check or had its records edited.

nodes.name: Slack: Weekly Digest (#email-health)
nodes.notes: Every run: one line per domain with its warnings and blockers.

nodes.name: Guard: Anything Needs Attention?
nodes.notes: Yes only when something changed for the worse, so the alert channel stays worth reading.

nodes.name: Slack: Alert on Change (#martech-alerts)
nodes.notes: What changed, what it means and how to fix it.
